items.markdown:
Knights stopped existing as military forces because `new weapons, changing economies, and professional armies made them obsolete by the 16th and 17th centuries`.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFcdBjsvzrhmdJRGDV8pQ-ZhFD_aCjkdUnafKvFc9m1fAsjgMGj0mFHlGkM6oCNROZVxhOkioBgDf7RfPeLClNx1BiyoLtQ8Go1JgmPloTTvAXYxGuY-90_nY2mJhOQW-vR-iDsR_jbnoL13oRMxtXp8RIB9ncv42BLppE8_XKJ88bEDa_FuW8ztEpvnRHuigL-sBG8E) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFcdBjsvzrhmdJRGDV8pQ-ZhFD_aCjkdUnafKvFc9m1fAsjgMGj0mFHlGkM6oCNROZVxhOkioBgDf7RfPeLClNx1BiyoLtQ8Go1JgmPloTTvAXYxGuY-90_nY2mJhOQW-vR-iDsR_jbnoL13oRMxtXp8RIB9ncv42BLppE8_XKJ88bEDa_FuW8ztEpvnRHuigL-sBG8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEB6zswFa26CSPO86S-x1_-uZNs6Ds0MBI8RzXXXgpDkK_0J08GjmGvYfbsnWoYv1GZtfZ6S92hxNjI6RltabrVpt1oXVXlQhatR_WkbatEimm7OWtU491oaghrvvXKgyDrNRyXG9GhGsozdXCSgcp-EHtO6503qJRQPFInCOOa2-EvsS0JRg)

New Weapons and Tactics

- **Gunpowder:** Cannons, muskets, and pistols easily pierced heavy steel armor.
- **Massed Infantry:** Longbows, crossbows, and tight formations of pikemen allowed trained common soldiers to defeat mounted cavalry.
- **Loss of Superiority:** A low-cost gunman could destroy a heavily armored knight who took years to train.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEB6zswFYR7NFtZXB0Ftnm9A2FAJJtWg1aASGqPGi76Reh5IzR1uGEo39dGO1gPI6ymCnabGLoJHTrsqgttAfxIXvseFvjq6LSroMpGjbob3DVqKCgy0-TXiiTaBuf0-4f58o1YBLb9vzl4gvKMAqhj1PZYEpiAs29zVjDwLdv_NDUzQiskkUTY) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEB6zswFYR7NFtZXB0Ftnm9A2FAJJtWg1aASGqPGi76Reh5IzR1uGEo39dGO1gPI6ymCnabGLoJHTrsqgttAfxIXvseFvjq6LSroMpGjbob3DVqKCgy0-TXiiTaBuf0-4f58o1YBLb9vzl4gvKMAqhj1PZYEpiAs29zVjDwLdv_NDUzQiskkUTY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVjwd_5ezWW3jnT_JJFLRP1eTnQnGfocRQlXAdbvKkvd_8Dbn6uJrROdxFI91uDkXjqFu7Lhwu-H0jlJ6Lo4jghUq09WA65JpaZw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAV8O6PTGUYThl1gEEl8LS4wXBXnskX1zB4aWFYJbieVD5PkmbU59BXt4jL6NnvYRSFiifrE6OKM08jCrH-lMrkdcNp74gleNfR1tM_5hqsE38iUPLpEcUF-EG-Gzeic29TZqsSteyQ-XHAX-eSx2MrxslKB14o7S8P)

Economic and Social Shifts

- **High Costs:** Maintaining a warhorse, armor, and weapons for a knight became too expensive for many local lords.
- **Professional Armies:** Kings began hiring cheaper mercenaries and creating permanent national armies instead of relying on feudal military service.
- **End of Feudalism:** As societies centralized, the feudal system that traded land for military duty faded away.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFcdBjsvzrhmdJRGDV8pQ-ZhFD_aCjkdUnafKvFc9m1fAsjgMGj0mFHlGkM6oCNROZVxhOkioBgDf7RfPeLClNx1BiyoLtQ8Go1JgmPloTTvAXYxGuY-90_nY2mJhOQW-vR-iDsR_jbnoL13oRMxtXp8RIB9ncv42BLppE8_XKJ88bEDa_FuW8ztEpvnRHuigL-sBG8E) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFcdBjsvzrhmdJRGDV8pQ-ZhFD_aCjkdUnafKvFc9m1fAsjgMGj0mFHlGkM6oCNROZVxhOkioBgDf7RfPeLClNx1BiyoLtQ8Go1JgmPloTTvAXYxGuY-90_nY2mJhOQW-vR-iDsR_jbnoL13oRMxtXp8RIB9ncv42BLppE8_XKJ88bEDa_FuW8ztEpvnRHuigL-sBG8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESRwHrOzAVwZzLgGo6LNR--Qie6nsu7qRgWqKOeA5ZentnSe0QtWanhhiCQylgcvjdTLLj-AMLAPVZFy_PM0rZOpmz9Dgd8yuO)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFUfkzhZW2jrwNGixnBsin5RxOris6UZyPxDnEBJq7igfZU5BHwh5POgonz9Eno5DctGkB1pdNmlXl4yFLmGRPVKFk6y0rKGoG9gwPt6-lqQ9fmmBgh59iRC2vXddL1DoIWmIaxUJu7ECg5Hj79zOp5his09WqZbYDIPDQ42j)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHrOzAVkDKVOhb25a1t-2JvtIulD35Bkqdh4dRdmXsekisGwTqMkLntiYcpH8rznohRE00R_wpPB6JUXXZm6_C-vStUid_BehuUH_zBE47JkvBtnRHvhre4bKOYhQSFQxc)

By the 1500s, the active military role of the knight was gone, leaving knighthood as a purely honorary title.[](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHrOzAVs31hYFpCfp15scvBgDrvIhwkqtbGmHcao95qBR3c3ijbOb3LSTVW-VpJCIY9TEKMhcNuj-mQ5ooRyslu07cdK45FW8PqJLS3CStEGgkK0Vs) [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHrOzAVs31hYFpCfp15scvBgDrvIhwkqtbGmHcao95qBR3c3ijbOb3LSTVW-VpJCIY9TEKMhcNuj-mQ5ooRyslu07cdK45FW8PqJLS3CStEGgkK0Vs)Would you like to know more about **how armor evolved** to try and fight gunpowder, or about the **transition to professional armies**?
